summary: APA – The Engineered Wood Association is a nonprofit trade association representing the United States and Canadian engineered wood products industry. It represents manufacturers and handles functions such as quality testing, product research, and market development. Its corporate headquarters in Tacoma, Washington includes an office building and a 42,000-square-foot Research Center, and a regional quality testing laboratory is located in Atlanta, Georgia.
one_line: APA – The Engineered Wood Association is a nonprofit trade group for the US and Canadian engineered wood industry, headquartered in Tacoma, Washington.
